verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs state that clipboard history is provided by the bundled Walker launcher, covers both text and images, and opens with a single hotkey, Super + Ctrl + V. That matches every element of the story. The manual also describes unified clipboard hotkeys that work (almost) everywhere. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and any documented detail on history depth, persistence or search behavior beyond a one-line description.
